lead.titleZh: 多发性硬化症：CBT联用普拉提改善平衡步态；卒中：居家康复新证据
lead.titleEn: MS: CBT + Pilates for Balance/Gait; Stroke: New Evidence for Home Rehab
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 19 份条目，涵盖 8 个专业方向。神经康复领域有 2 篇最高分（85 分）研究值得关注：一篇 RCT 提示多发性硬化症患者疲劳聚焦认知行为疗法结合普拉提可改善平衡和步态，另一篇系统综述和荟萃分析总结了卒中患者上肢运动功能恢复的居家康复策略。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 19 entries span 8 specialties. In neurorehabilitation, two top-scoring studies (85 points) merit attention: an RCT suggesting fatigue-focused cognitive behavior therapy combined with Pilates improves balance and gait in MS patients, and a systematic review and meta-analysis summarizing self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb motor recovery in stroke.

items.title: A Qualitative Study Investigating Sex Differences in the Needs and Priorities of Lower Limb Prosthesis Users
items.summary: A qualitative study of 18 lower limb prosthesis users (9 female, 9 male) found sex-specific differences across prosthetic fit, physical, and psychosocial experiences, including female-specific challenges with prosthetic fit and ambulation, frustrations with clinicians, and concerns regarding maternity and child-rearing.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究发现，下肢假肢使用者在假肢适配、身体功能和心理社会方面存在显著的性别差异，女性在假肢佩戴、步态挑战、对临床医生的沮丧以及生育和育儿方面有独特需求。这提示你在康复和假肢设计中，必须考虑这些性别特异性因素，以提供更个性化的服务。
items.titleZh: 一项调查下肢假肢使用者需求和优先事项性别差异的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 18 名下肢假肢使用者（9 名女性，9 名男性）的定性研究发现，在假肢适配、身体功能和心理社会经历方面存在性别特异性差异，包括女性在假肢适配和行走方面的独特挑战、对临床医生的沮丧以及对生育和育儿的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study found significant sex differences in prosthetic fit, physical function, and psychosocial aspects among lower limb prosthesis users, with women having unique needs in prosthetic wear, gait challenges, frustration with clinicians, and concerns about maternity and child-rearing. This indicates that you must consider these sex-specific factors in rehabilitation and prosthetic design to provide more personalized services.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（18 名假肢使用者，男女各 9 名），且为定性研究，结果可能不具有普遍代表性；研究依赖自我报告，可能存在主观性。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (18 prosthesis users, 9 male and 9 female) and qualitative nature limit generalizability; relies on self-reported data, which may introduce subjectivity.

items.title: Long-term outcomes following non-operative treatment of grade II and III medial collateral ligament injuries with and without concomitant ACL injury
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=154 patients) with a mean 11.5-year follow-up found that non-operatively managed Grade II and III medial collateral ligament (MCL) injuries, with or without concomitant ACL injury, had comparable patient-reported and radiographic outcomes, except for a lower Tegner activity scale in Grade III MCL/ACL injuries.
items.curatedReason: 这项长期随访研究显示，非手术治疗的 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤（无论是否合并 ACL 损伤）患者，其患者报告结局和影像学结果差异不大。这意味着你在临床中，对于孤立性 MCL III 级损伤，可以更有信心地采用非手术治疗方案，但对合并 ACL 损伤的 III 级 MCL 患者，仍需注意其 Tegner 活动评分可能较低。
items.titleZh: 非手术治疗 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带损伤（伴或不伴前交叉韧带损伤）的长期结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 154 名患者进行平均 11.5 年随访的前瞻性队列研究发现，非手术治疗的 II 级和 III 级内侧副韧带（MCL）损伤（无论是否合并前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤），其患者报告结局和影像学结果具有可比性，但 III 级 MCL 合并 ACL 损伤的 Tegner 活动评分较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This long-term follow-up study shows that non-operatively treated Grade II and III medial collateral ligament (MCL) injuries, with or without concomitant ACL injury, had comparable patient-reported and radiographic outcomes. This implies that you can be more confident in non-operative management for isolated Grade III MCL injuries in your practice, but should still note the potentially lower Tegner activity scale for Grade III MCL injuries with concomitant ACL injury.
items.limitation: 观察性队列研究，不能完全排除混杂因素；尽管是长期随访，但一些子组的样本量可能相对较小，影响统计效力。
items.limitationEn: Observational cohort study, which cannot entirely exclude confounding factors; despite long-term follow-up, some subgroup sample sizes may be relatively small, affecting statistical power.

items.title: Impact of Adding Fatigue-Focused Cognitive Behavior Therapy to Supervised Pilates-Based Core Stability Training on Balance and Walking in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: Adding fatigue-focused CBT to Pilates-based core stability training significantly improved balance and gait in multiple sclerosis patients, with a between-group mean difference of -0.59 in overall stability index (95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001) and 8.22 steps/min in cadence (95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001) after 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 疲劳聚焦的认知行为疗法（CBT）结合普拉提核心稳定性训练，能更显著改善多发性硬化症患者的平衡和步态，其综合效应优于单一普拉提训练。这提示 PT 在处理 MS 患者疲劳时，应考虑整合认知行为策略。
items.titleZh: 疲劳聚焦认知行为疗法结合普拉提核心稳定性训练对多发性硬化症患者平衡和步态影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对多发性硬化症患者进行的 RCT 发现，将疲劳聚焦的 CBT 添加到普拉提核心稳定性训练中，可显著改善平衡和步态，8 周后两组间总体稳定性指数平均差为 -0.59（95% CI: -0.70 至 -0.48；p < .001），步频平均差为 8.22 步/分钟（95% CI: 4.40 至 12.04；p < .001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fatigue-focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) combined with Pilates-based core stability training significantly improves balance and gait in multiple sclerosis patients, outperforming Pilates alone. This suggests PTs should consider integrating cognitive-behavioral strategies when addressing fatigue in MS patients.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明认知行为疗法的具体组成和剂量，可能影响结果的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific components and dosage of cognitive behavioral therapy, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb motor recovery in people with stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (8 independent cohorts) found that self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb recovery in stroke patients showed no significant advantage over other interventions (SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23 to 0.44), but may offer comparable functional benefits.
items.curatedReason: 对卒中患者而言，居家自我指导的上肢康复与常规疗法效果相当，可作为有效且可及的替代方案。当患者无法常规就诊时，不必担心居家方案效果不佳；但要注意，目前证据质量仍有提升空间。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者上肢运动功能恢复的自我指导居家康复：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖14项研究（8个独立队列）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，卒中患者上肢康复的自我指导居家方案与传统干预相比无显著优势（SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23至0.44），但可能提供相当的功能效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, self-guided home-based upper limb rehabilitation is comparable to conventional therapy, making it a viable and accessible alternative. Don't worry about inferior outcomes when patients can't attend regular appointments, but be aware that the evidence quality still needs improvement.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的干预措施在结构、持续时间和策略上差异较大，且方法学质量中等，异质性偏高，需要更高质量的研究确认疗效。
items.limitationEn: The included interventions varied significantly in structure, duration, and strategies, with moderate methodological quality and high heterogeneity, requiring higher-quality studies to confirm efficacy.

items.title: Impact of Rehabilitation Initiation Timing on Safety and Efficacy in Patients With Acute Stroke and Concurrent Heart Failure.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 9827 acute stroke patients with heart failure found very early rehabilitation (admission day/day 1) was associated with lower in-hospital respiratory failure (RR = 0.58), lower 90-day stroke readmission (RR = 0.33), and a higher discharge Barthel Index (mean difference = 3.66) compared to delayed rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者早期康复（入院当天或第 1 天）与更低的院内呼吸衰竭风险、90 天卒中再入院率以及更高的出院 Barthel 指数相关。这支持了在心衰患者中，若血液动力学稳定，仍应尽早启动康复。
items.titleZh: 康复启动时机对急性卒中合并心力衰竭患者安全性和疗效的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 9827 例急性卒中合并心力衰竭患者的回顾性队列研究发现，非常早期康复（入院当天/第 1 天）与更低的院内呼吸衰竭（RR = 0.58）、更低的 90 天卒中再入院率（RR = 0.33）和更高的出院 Barthel 指数（平均差 = 3.66）相关，优于延迟康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early rehabilitation (on admission day or day 1) in stroke patients with concurrent heart failure is associated with lower in-hospital respiratory failure risk, 90-day stroke readmission rates, and higher discharge Barthel Index. This supports initiating rehabilitation early in heart failure patients if hemodynamically stable.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，结果存在混杂因素，且数据未能提供康复干预的详细强度和具体原因。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational study has confounding factors, and the data did not provide detailed information on rehabilitation intensity or specific reasons for delays.

items.title:
Feasibility, safety, and preliminary effects of haptic cane-assisted gait training in chronic hemiparetic stroke: a pilot randomized crossover trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A pilot randomized crossover trial (n=20) in chronic hemiparetic stroke patients found haptic cane-assisted gait training to be feasible and safe, with 97.1% adherence and no adverse events. However, it showed no additional improvement in self-selected gait speed (adjusted between-treatment difference –0.009 m/s, 95% CI –0.032 to 0.013; p = 0.41) compared to conventional gait training.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步随机交叉试验显示，触觉手杖辅助步态训练在慢性偏瘫性卒中患者中是可行且安全的，但其步速改善效果并未优于剂量匹配的常规步态训练。在将触觉手杖纳入常规实践之前，你需要等待更多研究评估其更深层的机制性结局。
items.titleZh: 触觉手杖辅助步态训练在慢性偏瘫性卒中中的可行性、安全性及初步效果：一项试点随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 20 名慢性偏瘫性卒中患者进行的试点随机交叉试验发现，触觉手杖辅助步态训练可行且安全，依从性达 97.1%，无不良事件。然而，与常规步态训练相比，其在自主选择步速方面未显示额外改善（经调整的治疗间差异 –0.009 m/s, 95% CI –0.032 至 0.013; p = 0.41）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot randomized crossover trial indicates that haptic cane-assisted gait training is feasible and safe for chronic hemiparetic stroke patients, but it did not provide additional improvement in gait speed over dose-matched conventional gait training. Before integrating haptic canes into routine practice, you should await further studies evaluating outcomes more closely aligned with its proposed mechanism.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点随机交叉试验，样本量较小（n=20），结果的普遍性有限；研究发现两种干预方案在步速上无显著差异，但可能对其他未测结局存在影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized crossover trial with a small sample size (n=20), limiting generalizability; it found no significant difference in gait speed between interventions, but other unmeasured outcomes might be affected.

items.title: Physiotherapists' experiences of managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 14 UK physiotherapists revealed challenges in managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease, including perceived inadequate assessment tools, limited evidence, and systemic constraints, despite sophisticated clinical reasoning.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了物理治疗师在处理帕金森病患者转弯困难时面临的挑战，包括评估工具不足和缺乏基于证据的协议。这突出说明了该领域需要更系统化的评估方法和治疗指南。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师管理帕金森病转弯困难的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 名英国物理治疗师进行的定性研究揭示了管理帕金森病转弯困难的挑战，包括评估工具不足、证据有限和系统性制约，尽管临床推理复杂。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights challenges physical therapists face when managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease, including inadequate assessment tools and a lack of evidence-based protocols. This underscores the need for more systematic assessment methods and treatment guidelines in this area.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果基于少数物理治疗师的感知和经验，不代表客观证据或普遍实践。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study's findings are based on the perceptions and experiences of a small number of physical therapists, not objective evidence or universal practice.

items.title: Defining Constructs of Hand Function Quality at Home After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury Through Egocentric Videos: A Qualitative Inquiry
items.summary: A qualitative study using focus groups (N=17) identified 14 categories and 33 constructs to describe the quality of hand function in unconstrained, in-home activities after cervical spinal cord injury (cSCI), captured through egocentric videos.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究通过以自我为中心视角视频，定义了颈脊髓损伤（cSCI）患者居家环境中手功能质量的构建要素。这有助于物理治疗师更全面地评估患者真实世界中的手功能，从而制定更贴合实际的康复目标。
items.titleZh: 通过以自我为中心视角视频定义颈脊髓损伤后居家手功能质量的构建要素：一项定性探究
items.summaryZh: 一项通过焦点小组（N=17）进行的定性研究，通过以自我为中心视角视频，确定了 14 个类别和 33 个构建要素，用于描述颈脊髓损伤（cSCI）后居家非受限活动中手功能的质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study, using egocentric videos, defined constructs for hand function quality at home after cervical spinal cord injury (cSCI). This helps physical therapists more comprehensively assess patients' real-world hand function, leading to more practical rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，结果基于焦点小组的感知和讨论，不直接提供量化的干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study; its findings are based on focus group perceptions and discussions, not direct quantitative intervention effects.

items.title: Validity and Reliability of the Performanz Spark for Measuring Sprint Performance in Young Male Basketball Players
items.summary: This study evaluated the validity and reliability of the Performanz Spark device for measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players, providing support for its use in athletic assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 Performanz Spark 设备在测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现方面的有效性和可靠性。这对于运动康复领域的物理治疗师和体能教练评估运动员进展、优化训练方案提供了工具支持。
items.titleZh: Performanz Spark 测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现的有效性和可靠性
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了 Performanz Spark 设备测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现的有效性和可靠性，为其在运动评估中的应用提供了支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validated the Performanz Spark device for measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players. This provides tool support for physical therapists and strength coaches in sports rehabilitation to assess athlete progress and optimize training programs.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于年轻男性篮球运动员，结果的通用性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were limited to young male basketball players, which may limit the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Application of the ICF in the functioning assessment of children with suspected developmental coordination difficulties.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=208) using the ICF framework found that children with probable Developmental Coordination Disorder (p-DCD) showed lower motor skills in activities and significantly lower involvement in community participation (p = 0.016) compared to typically neurodeveloping children.
items.curatedReason: 有发育性协调障碍（p-DCD）的儿童，不仅运动技能受限，在社区参与度上也会显著降低。评估这类患儿时，除了关注其动作表现，你更要深入了解他们的社交互动和日常活动参与，因为这些往往被忽视，却对其长期功能至关重要。
items.titleZh: ICF在疑似发育性协调障碍儿童功能评估中的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对208名儿童的横断面研究使用ICF框架发现，疑似发育性协调障碍（p-DCD）儿童在活动中的运动技能较低，并且在社区参与方面的投入显著更低（p = 0.016），提示运动挑战对其功能和参与有影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Children with probable Developmental Coordination Disorder (p-DCD) not only have motor skill limitations but also significantly lower community participation. When assessing these children, go beyond motor performance to explore their social interaction and daily activity involvement, as these often-overlooked aspects are crucial for their long-term function.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且研究人群来自巴西南部，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, and the study population from Southern Brazil may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of an exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) on physical function in community-dwelling older adults: protocol for a single-centre, assessor-blinded, parallel-group randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This single-center, assessor-blinded, parallel-group RCT protocol aims to evaluate an AI-based exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) in 142 community-dwelling older adults in Beijing over 8 weeks, compared to a standardized program, with the primary outcome being a composite physical function Z-score.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项RCT协议，提示我们未来可能会有基于AI的个性化运动处方系统（ACTIVE）可用于社区老年人。如果这项研究证明其有效，这将在居家运动管理和提升依从性方面提供可扩展的辅助工具。
items.titleZh: 运动处方系统（ACTIVE）对社区老年人身体功能影响的随机对照试验方案：单中心、评估者盲法、平行组研究
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心、评估者盲法、平行组随机对照试验方案旨在评估一项基于 AI 的运动处方系统（ACTIVE）对 142 名北京社区老年人 8 周干预后的身体功能影响，主要结局指标是综合身体功能 Z 值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol suggests a future AI-based personalized exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) for community-dwelling older adults. If proven effective, this could offer a scalable tool for home exercise management and adherence, but for now, it's just a protocol.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未发布最终结果，且为单中心研究，结果外推性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet available. Being a single-center study, the generalizability of its findings remains to be verified.

items.title: Older Adults and Healthcare Professionals Perspectives on Comfort, Dignity, and Safety During Technology-Assisted Transfers: A Qualitative Descriptive Study
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study with 15 older adults and 15 healthcare professionals revealed that comfort, dignity, and safety during technology-assisted transfers are interconnected and co-constructed through interactions, emphasizing the importance of relational practices, staff training, and equipment customization.
items.curatedReason: 使用辅助技术进行老年患者转移，舒适度、尊严和安全感并非孤立存在，而是医患互动中共同构建的。在技术操作之外，务必重视与患者的沟通、隐私维护和持续照护，这将显著提升患者的整体体验。
items.titleZh: 老年人和医疗专业人员对技术辅助转移中舒适度、尊严和安全性的视角：一项定性描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对15位老年人和15位医疗专业人员的定性描述性研究显示，技术辅助转移中的舒适度、尊严和安全性是相互关联并经由互动共同构建的，强调了关系实践、员工培训和设备定制的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: When using assistive technology for older adult transfers, comfort, dignity, and safety are not isolated; they are co-constructed through interactions. Beyond technical operation, you must prioritize communication, privacy, and continuous care with patients, as these significantly enhance their overall experience.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（15名老年人，15名医护人员），结果的普遍性受限，无法进行量化推断。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (15 older adults, 15 healthcare professionals), limiting the generalizability of the findings and precluding quantitative inferences.

items.title: Multimodal Prehabilitation in People Awaiting Acute Inpatient Cardiac Surgery (PreP-ACe): A single-arm feasibility study
items.summary: A single-arm feasibility study (N=17) for multimodal prehabilitation in acute inpatient cardiac surgery patients found a recruitment rate of 1.5 participants/month, 100% adherence to exercise with >80% tolerability, and no adverse events related to the intervention, indicating feasibility despite implementation challenges.
items.curatedReason: 急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复方案似乎是可行的，患者对运动的依从性和耐受性均超过80%，且未报告不良事件。这提示我们该方案有潜力，但实际推行时，你仍需应对招募、人员配备和资金等挑战。
items.titleZh: 急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复（PreP-ACe）：一项单臂可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对急性住院心脏外科患者的多模式预康复单臂可行性研究（N=17）显示，招募率为每月1.5人，运动依从性100%，耐受性超过80%，且无运动相关不良事件，表明该方案在实施挑战下仍具可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal prehabilitation appears feasible for acute inpatient cardiac surgery patients, with over 80% exercise adherence and tolerability, and no reported adverse events. This suggests potential for the program, but you'll still face challenges in recruitment, staffing, and funding during implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂可行性研究，样本量小（N=17），缺乏对照组，无法评估干预的实际疗效，且结论局限于可行性。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm feasibility study with a small sample size (N=17) and no control group, preventing evaluation of intervention efficacy and limiting conclusions to feasibility.

items.title: Manual techniques for headache: who delivers what and where? A systematic review of randomized controlled trials with a practice-mapping analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review of 35 RCTs on manual techniques for headache found that spinal manipulation was predominant (60%) and applied mainly to tension-type (40%) and cervicogenic (29%) headaches. Practice-mapping showed technique application varied significantly by professional background, departmental setting, and geographic localization (p = 0.044, p = 0.0012, p < 0.001) rather than headache type.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，手法治疗在头痛管理中广泛应用，但具体技术选择更受专业背景、机构设置和地域实践传统影响，而非标准化、诊断驱动。这提示物理治疗师需要加强证据结合，避免过度依赖区域经验。
items.titleZh: 手法治疗头痛：谁在何处提供何种服务？一项随机对照试验的系统综述与实践映射分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 35 项关于头痛手法治疗的 RCT 进行的系统综述发现，脊柱手法是主要技术（60%），主要应用于紧张性头痛（40%）和颈源性头痛（29%）。实践映射显示，技术应用因专业背景、部门设置和地理位置（p = 0.044, p = 0.0012, p < 0.001）而异，而非头痛类型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that manual techniques are widely used in headache management, but specific technique selection is more influenced by professional background, institutional setting, and regional practice traditions, rather than standardized, diagnosis-driven approaches. This suggests physical therapists need to strengthen evidence integration and avoid over-reliance on regional experience.
items.limitation: 该综述主要侧重于实践映射分析，未对各种手法治疗的实际疗效进行深入评价。
items.limitationEn: The review primarily focused on practice-mapping analysis and did not deeply evaluate the actual efficacy of various manual therapy techniques.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Thoracic expansion and spirometry 120 days after adding diaphragmatic manual therapy to physiotherapy in non-specific low back pain: Follow-up of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A follow-up to an RCT (N=50) found that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to physiotherapy for non-specific low back pain patients significantly increased inspiratory thoracic expansion at axillary (3.38 cm), xiphoid (3.52 cm), and basal (4.12 cm) levels, as well as forced vital capacity (1.57 L) and forced expiratory volume in one second (1.49 L) at 120 days (all p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT的随访结果表明，在常规物理治疗中加入手法膈肌牵伸，能显著提高非特异性腰痛患者的吸气胸廓扩张度和肺活量，且这些改善在120天内保持稳定。虽然需要更多证据支持，但你可以考虑在腰痛患者的综合治疗方案中探索性地加入膈肌手法治疗。
items.titleZh: 在非特异性腰痛的物理治疗中加入手法膈肌治疗对胸廓扩张和肺活量的120天随访结果：一项随机对照试验的随访
items.summaryZh: 一项针对50名非特异性腰痛患者的随机对照试验的随访发现，在物理治疗中加入手法膈肌牵伸，在120天时显著增加了腋窝（3.38厘米）、剑突（3.52厘米）和基底（4.12厘米）水平的吸气胸廓扩张度，以及用力肺活量（1.57升）和第一秒用力呼气容积（1.49升）（均 p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT follow-up indicates that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to conventional physiotherapy significantly improves inspiratory thoracic expansion and spirometric values in non-specific low back pain patients, with benefits maintained at 120 days. While more evidence is needed, you might consider exploratively incorporating diaphragmatic manual therapy into comprehensive treatment plans for low back pain.
items.limitation: 该研究缺乏受试者盲法和假对照组，且使用了便携式肺活量计，结果可能需要通过使用实验室肺活量计的假对照试验进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked participant blinding and a sham comparator, and used portable spirometry, meaning findings require confirmation in sham-controlled trials using laboratory spirometry.

items.title: CMS Proposes Reforms to Strengthen Competition, Elevate Care Quality, and Expand Beneficiary Choice in Medicare Advantage
items.summary: CMS is proposing reforms to strengthen competition, elevate care quality, and expand beneficiary choice within the Medicare Advantage (MA) program, which could impact future service provision and reimbursement for MA patients.
items.curatedReason: CMS 正在提议改革 Medicare Advantage (MA) 计划，旨在加强竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择。虽然细节仍待最终确定，但这些变化可能会影响你未来为 MA 患者提供的服务范围和报销模式，务必密切关注最终规则的发布。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 CMS 提议改革以加强 Medicare Advantage 竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择
items.summaryZh: CMS 正在提议改革 Medicare Advantage (MA) 计划，旨在加强竞争、提升护理质量并扩大受益人选择，这可能会影响未来 MA 患者的服务提供和报销模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is proposing reforms to Medicare Advantage (MA) plans, aiming to enhance competition, improve care quality, and expand beneficiary choice. While details are pending, these changes could affect the scope of services and reimbursement models for your MA patients, so closely monitor the final rule's release.

items.title: Contract Year 2028 Policy and Technical Changes to the Medicare Advantage Program, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program, and Medicare Cost Plan Program (CMS-4214-P2)
items.summary: CMS has released proposed policy and technical changes for the Contract Year 2028 Medicare Advantage Program, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program, and Medicare Cost Plan Program (CMS-4214-P2), which could impact physical therapy service provision and reimbursement in the US market.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了 2028 年合同年度 Medicare Advantage (MA) 和 Medicare 处方药福利计划的政策和技术修改拟议规则。这些拟议规则可能会影响你在美国市场向 MA 患者提供物理治疗服务的合规性、报销和运营模式，请务必详细审阅并准备提交意见。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 2028 合同年度 Medicare Advantage 计划、Medicare 处方药福利计划和 Medicare 费用计划的政策与技术修改 (CMS-4214-P2)
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了 2028 年合同年度 Medicare Advantage 计划、Medicare 处方药福利计划和 Medicare 费用计划（CMS-4214-P2）的政策和技术修改拟议规则，这可能影响美国市场物理治疗服务的提供和报销。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released proposed policy and technical changes for the Contract Year 2028 Medicare Advantage (MA) and Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Programs. These proposed rules may impact the compliance, reimbursement, and operational models for your physical therapy services to MA patients in the US market, so review them thoroughly and prepare to submit comments.

items.title: State Advocacy for Imaging Orders by Physical Therapist
items.summary: APTA has published resources for state chapters to advocate for physical therapists' authority to order imaging studies, providing background on current regulations, links to state laws where this is permitted, and model legislative language for advocacy efforts in the US.
items.curatedReason: APTA 已发布关于物理治疗师影像检查医嘱权的州级倡议资源。如果你在美国执业，务必了解你所在州的具体法律，因为各州规定差异很大。这些资源是推动或支持扩大执业范围立法的重要工具。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师影像检查医嘱权的州级倡议 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 发布了州级资源，旨在帮助各州分会倡导物理治疗师开具影像检查医嘱的权力，其中包含当前法规背景、已允许该权限的州法律链接以及用于美国倡议的模型立法语言。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released state advocacy resources concerning physical therapists' (PTs') authority to order imaging studies. If you practice in the US, it's crucial to understand your specific state's laws, as regulations vary significantly. These resources are valuable tools for advancing or supporting legislation to expand your scope of practice.

items.title: [Correspondence] The Lancet Group's guidance on reporting disability: make link to the ICF explicit
items.summary: Correspondence suggests that The Lancet Group's guidance on reporting disability should explicitly link to WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to enhance inclusivity in health research.
items.curatedReason: 这封信函建议《柳叶刀》杂志在残疾报告指南中明确提及WHO的国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF），这对物理治疗师理解和应用残疾分类标准具有参考意义。
items.titleZh: 书信：《柳叶刀》杂志关于残疾报告的指南：明确与ICF的联系。
items.summaryZh: 书信建议《柳叶刀》杂志关于残疾报告的指南应明确与WHO的《国际功能、残疾和健康分类》（ICF）建立联系，以增强健康研究的包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter suggests that The Lancet's disability reporting guidelines explicitly reference WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF), which is relevant for physical therapists in understanding and applying disability classification standards.
